notes: Home now shows the Monday to Friday Mass schedule with a countdown, and the red dots for new messages and announcements are fixed.
new: The Home card is now Monday to Friday Mass. It shows the Mass time and venue for each weekday, and a live countdown to today's Mass, or the next one if today's has passed.
The priest and founder can edit the time and venue for each weekday from the card.
changed: Fixed: the red dots for new chat messages and announcements now show reliably. They update on every screen change, when you come back to the app, and every minute.
